page: Microsoft Azure EC96ads_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECADSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor. The system is equipped with 672.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.0 GB per vCPU.

For storage, the instance includes 3686 GB of local SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. There are no GPUs integrated into this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the EC96ads_v5 offers high resource density, combining a large memory footprint with substantial local SSD capacity on a single virtual machine. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, enterprise applications, and data-processing tasks that require high memory-to-vCPU ratios and fast local storage.
description: Microsoft Azure EC96ads_v5 is a memory-optimized server instance from the ECADSv5 family, utilizing an x86_64 AMD processor and virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. The combination of high-capacity memory and substantial local SSD storage makes the EC96ads_v5 highly efficient for hosting large enterprise databases, memory-intensive analytics, and complex data processing pipelines.
